inlines.v: AD'EQUATE, adjective Equal; proportionate; correspondent to; fully sufficient; as, means adequate to the object; we have no adequate ideas of infinite power. Adequate ideas, are such as exactly represent their object. AD'EQUATE, verb transitive To resemble exactly. [Not used.]
